book.name: 2 Corintios
book.title: Pablo awentsaik carta agaja corintonmaya aidau awetimu

content: Jutiik Apajuí chichame etsegbaunum yaimin asaja segajime: Apajuí wait anenkagtamun iwaintugmakua nu ayatak antukjum idaisaigpajum tusan.

content.text: “Tsawan wi antugmain jegau asamtai untsugkumin aikmajame,

content: Nu tsawantak yamaiya juuwai Apajuí aigmamainuk. ¡Yamaiya juuwai tsawan uwemaina dushakam!
Makichkish pegkegchauk iwaintuinatsji, ii takainag nuna pegkegchau chichajinum tuidau asaja.
Ayatak dekas Apajuin inakempap ainawa tusa dekagmatnume tabaunum, waitiakuish emamkesa, atsumakuish, utugchat akuish katsuntuinaji;
asutamainakuish, achipak egkepainakuish, ijuntugmag jiyapainakuish, imanisaik takainaku, kanutskesh tuke tsawampabiaji, yujumkash yutsuk yujabiaji,
nuniaku iwainmabaiji iina pujutinish pegkegchau atsugtabau, ii dekamushkam, wait anenkagtamu, Wakaní Pegkeji jutiiní pujau asa dekaskenum anejatbauwa dushakam;
chicham dekaskea nu etsegtanum nuigtush jutiiní Apajuí senchijí ajutjama nujai, jutii imagnisa pujuinaku tikich aidau chicham ujaku ii shiwaji aina nui ayamjumatnash sujamji;
eme anenjamush ainai, dakitjamaidaush ainawai, pegkegchau chichagtamainai, pegkejan chichagtamush ainawai, jutiik wait ainakuish, tujash dekaskenmag dekaskea nu chichau ainaji;
wainchatai utugmaina dutijamiagtaish tikichik shiig waipainaji, jakattaku yujakuish iwaaku pujuinaji, suwimkan sujamainakush mantamainatsui;
diismakek wake besemag ainaji, tujash tuke shiig aneasa pujuinaji, ujunauch ainakuish tikichik wiyakchamitkainaji, jutiinu atsugtamainakush ashí ajutjamainawai.
Yatsug corintionmaya aidauwah, jutiik dekaskenum ii anentaibaujiya duka uutsuk ashí ujakbaijime.
Jutiik makichkish atum uugkamuk atsugtamji, tujash atumek uuká anentaimjume.
Nunin asagmin (uchig anentsan tajime), wait aneasjum minash atum anentaibau ujatkatajum, wi atumin uutsuk tajim aikasjumek.
Atumek Jesusa dekaskeapi tuchau aina nujai ijuntsa takata duka wakejumaitsugme, wagki ¿pegkeja dusha pegkegchaujaish wajuk atuemainaita? ¿Nuigtush utugsaya tsaaptina dusha suwejaish apatdaimainaita?
Cristuk Iwanchjaig ijunmaitsui. Nunisag Cristun nemajuidaushkam Cristun nemagchau aina nujaig ijunmaitsui.
Jega Apajuí ememattaiya duka, apajuimtai dakumkamu aina nujaig makichkish apaemaitsui. Wagki jutiik Apajuí tuke pujuuwa nuna jee ainaji, nuadui Apajuí chichaak:

content.text: “Ditai pujustajai, nunikan ditajaig wetajai. Dita mina aentsug atinme, nuninakui wi dita Apajuiji atajai”, tiuwai.
nuniakjum kanaktajum pegkegchau aina duka takasaigpajum, nunikagmin wi atumnak jukitjime.
Wi atumin Apa atajai, tuja atum mina uchig, mina nawantug atajum, tiuwai Apu ashí senchigtina nunú”.
